create_mesh_collision_object: create a collision object from a mesh file at a given position with optional color
create_cuboid_collision_object: create a cuboid collision object with specified half extents, mass, and optional color
create_cube_collision_object: create a default cube collision object with configurable position, orientation, and mass
set_collision_object_state: set the position and orientation of a collision object in the simulation
load_urdf_cube_v2: load a colored or green cube v2 URDF model into the simulation at a given position
